sloka: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तो धन्वी त्वं रथमास्थितः।शरैर्वा यदि वाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्व पराक्रमम् ।। ६.७१.६० ।।
transliteration: sarvāyudhasamāyukto dhanvī tvaṁ rathamāsthitaḥ।śarairvā yadi vāpyastrairdarśayasva parākramam ।। 6.71.60 ।।

translations.english: "You are seated in the chariot with all kinds of weapons collected. By that alone you do not become capable. Show your capacity."
